method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Wall St starts the month strong as Mideast deal hopes rise
Equities.reason: Broad market risk-on narrative driven by easing US–Iran tensions and falling oil risk premium; lifts equities across regions. High relevance because it's a macro/regime move that is moving major indices and risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Stocks Rally as Amazon Hits $3 Trillion Market Cap; Chips Slide
Equities.reason: Reinforces AI-led leadership (Amazon hitting $3T) which is a dominant positive market narrative; chip weakness is a sector-level counter-signal so net is positive but not extreme.

Equities.title: US manufacturing activity jumps to more than four-year high in July
Equities.reason: Strong PMI/manufacturing data supports risk appetite and cyclical sectors; macro beat increases odds of growth resilience, boosting equity demand.

Equities.title: SpaceX's post-IPO plunge sets tense backdrop for first earnings report
Equities.summary: Two weeks after Tesla's earnings report was panned by Wall Street, Elon Musk faces investors again, but this time to discuss SpaceX's results.
Equities.reason: High-profile tech/IPO volatility (SpaceX) can sap risk appetite in growth/AI names; important single-stock event with broader tech sentiment transmission, but relevance limited vs macro moves.

Equities.title: Dip Buyers Need to Heed the Market’s Warning Signs
Equities.reason: Market caution commentary highlighting internal warning signs and concentration risks; serves as a meaningful counter-narrative to the rally and increases perceived downside risk for equities.

Equities.title: AstraZeneca holds talks with Bristol Myers Squibb over $400bn tie-up
Equities.summary: Deal would create world’s fourth-largest drugmaker by market value
Equities.reason: Very large potential M&A in pharmaceuticals — supports deal activity narrative and can lift sentiment in healthcare and broader M&A-sensitive markets; sector-focused but market-relevant given size.

Equities.title: Alibaba shares rally after unveiling its 'most powerful' AI model as U.S.-China competition heats up
Equities.summary: Alibaba unveiled its latest and 'most powerful' AI model Qwen3.8-Max on Monday as Chinese companies race to close the AI gap with the U.S.
Equities.reason: AI progress outside the US (Alibaba) reinforces the global tech/AI leadership narrative and risk-on flows into tech equities internationally; relevant but more regional/sectoral.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Labour data and hawkish risks in focus – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists outlines a United States (US) macro backdrop where the Federal Reserve (Fed) held rates but three officials dissented for a hike, keeping inflation concerns alive. They expect two further 25bp increases this year and closely watch upc
Rates.reason: Deutsche Bank expects additional 25bp hikes — a hawkish Fed path that implies higher Treasury yields (bond-selloff). High relevance because it directly signals near-term rate-hike expectations affecting the rates curve.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Data driven rate path – HSBC
Rates.summary: HSBC strategists note that the Federal Reserve (Fed) left policy rates unchanged in July, with markets now assigning a two-thirds probability to a September hike.
Rates.reason: Market pricing of a high probability for a September hike points to higher short-end yields; direct market-rate implication makes this relevant for rates positioning.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: Official FOMC statement is a primary driver of rate expectations; current messaging and any hawkish language are a material negative for bond prices (yields higher). High relevance as a core policy signal.

Rates.title: Japan’s Use of Fed Repo May Ease Pressure on Treasury Market
Rates.reason: Use of Fed repo by Japan to access USD liquidity can relieve strains in the Treasury market and reduce upward pressure on yields — supportive for bond prices and curve stabilization.

Rates.title: Bank Rate maintained at 3.75% - July 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: Bank Rate held at 3.75% — a neutral-to-mildly supportive outcome for UK gilts (no surprise tightening). Moderate relevance as it's a routine policy decision affecting local rates.

Rates.title: Latin America: Duration favored over carry – BNY
Rates.summary: Geoff Yu at BNY sees Brazil and Mexico operating in a more comfortable policy environment after the Fed decision, with anchored United States (US) front-end yields supporting emerging-market duration.
Rates.reason: Anchored US front-end yields supportive of taking duration in EM local markets — constructive for EM sovereign bond prices and duration exposures.

Rates.title: Chinese Government Bond Futures Kick Off Trading in Hong Kong
Rates.reason: Introduction of onshore Chinese G-bond futures in HK increases market access and liquidity, likely supportive for Chinese gov't bond markets (positive for bond prices / lower yields). Relevant for global rates flows into Asia.

Rates.title: How to Play the Flood of AI Bonds
Rates.reason: Surge in corporate issuance tied to AI strategies implies increased supply in credit markets which can push corporate yields higher (negative for bond prices), relevant to credit-sensitive rates.

Rates.title: Why people are dropping out of the workforce and not looking for new jobs: 'The market wore me down'
Rates.summary: Candidates giving up in the face of relentless job searches could be part of the reason behind recent declines in the labor force participation rate.
Rates.reason: Declining labour-force participation can dampen wage/inflation pressures, easing upside risks to rates — modestly positive for bond prices but lower relevance than direct policy news.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention supports JPY against US Dollar – BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports USD/JPY plunged in Tokyo after confirmed joint US-Japan intervention to stop the Japanese Yen’s slide, with officials warning they may act again.
FX.reason: Confirmed joint US–Japan FX intervention is a rare, high-impact event that materially strengthens JPY vs USD and alters USD funding/flow dynamics. This is a major FX regime signal — high direction and high relevance.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Joint intervention supports yen outlook – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that the Japanese Yen has strengthened as Japan and the US conducted joint intervention to counter recent volatility. He highlights planned use of the Federal Reserve’s FIMA Repo Facility, US euro-to-yen reallocations, and Japan’s size
FX.reason: Adds technical/mechanistic detail (FIMA repo, reallocations) that confirms intervention effectiveness and potential for follow-up actions — important corroboration of a dominant, market-moving JPY-support narrative.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention seen as containment – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner highlights rare joint US-Japan FX intervention, with Washington participating via the Fed and Japan using the FIMA repo facility to raise Dollars against Treasuries.
FX.reason: Market-structure take that frames the action as containment (short-term volatility management). Relevant to positioning/unwind risk for USD/JPY and cross-asset FX flows, but more confirmatory than novel.

FX.title: Japanese Yen holds firm after coordinated US-Japan intervention
FX.summary: USD/JPY steadies on Monday after a sharp decline at the weekly open fuelled speculation that authorities may have stepped into the market again following last week’s coordinated intervention by Japan and the United States (US).
FX.reason: Market reaction piece showing JPY stabilization after intervention — supports the prevailing narrative of active authorities and higher JPY sensitivity, with direct FX pair impact.

FX.title: Yen climbs as traders watch for further intervention
FX.reason: Reuters confirmation that market participants are pricing potential follow-up interventions — important for risk positioning and volatility in USD/JPY and related Asian FX. High market relevance despite brief summary.

FX.title: What the market is saying about the U.S. intervention to prop up the yen
FX.summary: Following the joint involvement the yen now sits at 157 to the dollar, down from just above 163, which represented its lowest level in four decades.
FX.reason: Sums up market reaction and scale of the move (large JPY appreciation). Useful for assessing immediate FX positioning and broader USD weakness implications — strong, market-moving confirmation.

FX.title: US Dollar: August weakness seen persisting – DBS
FX.summary: DBS Group Research economist Philip Wee argues that the Dollar’s outlook in August is weak after a sharp stumble at the end of July.
FX.reason: Analyst view that USD weakness will persist — complements the JPY intervention narrative and signals broader spillovers into other FX pairs. Moderate-high relevance for cross-market positioning.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar weakens on Oil price slump as markets eye data releases
FX.summary: USD/CAD trades around 1.4040 on Monday at the time of writing, up 0.14% on the day as the Canadian Dollar (CAD) comes under pressure following a sharp decline in Oil prices.
FX.reason: Oil-driven CAD weakness is a direct, commodity-linked FX move (USD/CAD higher). Relevant for CAD-specific flows and cross-hedges; offsets some broader non-USD strength but is idiosyncratic to commodity dynamics.

FX.title: Australian Dollar comes under pressure as US Dollar regains ground
FX.summary: AUD/USD falls to around 0.7000 on Monday at the time of writing, down 0.30% on the day, as a rebound in the US Dollar (USD) outweighs the support provided by Chinese economic data for the Australian Dollar (AUD).
FX.reason: Short-term USD rebound pressuring AUD; relevant for ANZ/Asia flows but lower relevance versus the dominant JPY intervention narrative. Treated as a near-term, pair-specific signal.

Commodities.title: China's crude oil imports fell in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: China, the world's largest importer of crude oil, imported less crude oil in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) following higher crude oil prices that resulted from disrupted flows through the Strait of Hormuz. China's lower imports reduced global demand, softe
Commodities.reason: Material demand datapoint from the world's largest crude importer — lower Chinese imports are an explicit downward force on oil fundamentals. High relevance given China's market weight.

Commodities.title: Lower crude oil prices reduced U.S.-Canada energy trade value in 2025
Commodities.summary: The value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau. Energy trade value is the total value of energy imports and exports between two countries and is dri
Commodities.reason: Lower crude prices cut trade value — a price-driven macro statistic with moderate relevance to oil market sentiment and cross-border flows, but not a direct supply shock.

Commodities.title: Gold consolidates as conflicting US-Iran headlines and hawkish Fed bets cap gains
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) trims gains after opening the week with a bullish gap as buyers lack conviction amid conflicting US-Iran headlines and caution ahead of key US employment data. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $4,036, easing from an intraday high of
Commodities.reason: Intraday/technical consolidation where hawkish Fed bets cap upside — mixed geopolitical headlines create lack of conviction. Relevant but primarily price/flow commentary (lower relevance cap).

Commodities.title: Gold firms as oil prices slump after Trump holds off on Iran attack
Commodities.reason: Major geopolitical decision (planned attack called off) moves energy risk premia; Reuters note that gold is firm despite oil slump — geopolitical/news-driven safe-haven flows give meaningful relevance.

Commodities.title: Investors scored on Iran war's oil market boom. Staying long the trade will get trickier
Commodities.summary: Oil price volatility caused by U.S.-Iran war created big market winners, but for buy-and-hold investors, there are better long-term energy themes to monitor.
Commodities.reason: Market retrospective that the wartime oil boom is fading and longer-term positioning is becoming tougher — signals a pullback/mean-reversion theme for oil with meaningful relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold: Explosive phase, muted correction – Deutsche Bank
Commodities.summary: Deutsche Bank Research analysts Michael Hsueh and Bryant Xu argue that Gold has been in an explosive price phase since August 2024, but recent moves suggest a muted correction.
Commodities.reason: Bank research framing implies continued bullish structural bias but expects only a muted correction — analytical/price-forecast content so relevance capped at technical max.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $58.38 per troy ounce, up 1.37% from the $57.59 it cost on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Intraday price uptick for silver — short-term positive but primarily a market data/price update (lower relevance).

Commodities.title: Oil prices fall to three-week low after Trump calls off planned attack
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical de-escalation (planned attack called off) removes a sizable oil risk premium, producing a notable near-term price drop — high relevance for oil markets.

Commodities.title: Oil: Hormuz risks keep prices in focus – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank's Senior Market Strategist Benjamin Picton discusses recurring Middle East tensions around the Strait of Hormuz and their impact on Oil and Brent.
Commodities.reason: Persistent Strait of Hormuz disruption risk is a structural upside risk premium for crude — clear supply-risk narrative with elevated relevance to oil price formation.

Commodities.title: Vertex Minerals announces first production firing at Reward Gold Mine
Commodities.reason: Company-level gold production milestone increases supply (albeit likely small in global terms) — mildly negative for gold, limited relevance due to single-asset scale.

Commodities.title: Indian Oil Subsidiary CPCL Plans 280,000 Bpd Manali Refinery
Commodities.reason: Planned large refinery capacity in India implies higher crude demand/throughput over time — supportive for oil balances and regionally relevant to crude flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin cold-wallet attack spreads to 4,500 addresses as losses near $89 million
Crypto.reason: Large, systemic cold-wallet exploit with substantial on-chain losses and contagion across thousands of addresses — immediate negative for crypto sentiment, liquidity and price; high relevance as a market-wide security shock.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin slips under $63,000 despite Iran deal hopes as Coldcard losses rattle market
Crypto.reason: Price breach tied to the Coldcard exploit shows direct market impact — negative for crypto risk asset performance and momentum, reinforcing sell-off narrative.

Crypto.title: Coldcard wallet losses may near $114 million as possible fourth sweep emerges
Crypto.reason: Escalation in estimated losses and continued on-chain sweeps increases systemic risk and uncertainty — very high relevance and negative for market confidence and prices.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, ether decline as Coldcard exploit enters a fifth day
Crypto.reason: Sustained multi-day exploit pressure driving declines in both BTC and ETH — confirms continuation risk and amplifies negative sentiment across major crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Strategy sold another $105 million of bitcoin last week, repurchased $81.2 million of STRC
Crypto.reason: Continued selling by a large institutional holder (net sales) represents an additional source of supply into a fragile market — negative for near-term price dynamics but lower relevance than the exploit itself.

Crypto.title: BlackRock expands tokenized cash with new blockchain-based money market offerings
Crypto.reason: Major asset manager expanding tokenized cash products is a clear institutional-adoption positive — improves on-chain liquidity and utility for institutional flows, supportive for longer-term crypto infrastructure and demand.

Crypto.title: Bernstein sees another leg lower for crypto markets if Clarity Act stalls
Crypto.reason: Policy uncertainty (Clarity Act) poses downside risk to market structure and institutional participation; conditional risk that could materially pressure prices if legislation fails to progress.

Crypto.title: Robinhood wins UK crypto registration before new regulatory regime kicks off
Crypto.reason: Exchange/operator gaining regulatory registration under a new regime is a positive for market access and regulatory normalization in a major market — modestly constructive for industry confidence.
